evidence.source: 教育部《異體字字典》 Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants (Taiwan)
evidence.field: 𤰈 entry; 說文釋形, 字樣說明, pronunciation and meaning
evidence.text: The entry for 𤰈 gives Mandarin bèi, quotes Shuowen’s analysis “具也。从用，茍省,” and says this character is the component in 備, later commonly written in a changed form. This supports a present-day Mandarin comparison of 𤰈 bèi with 備 bèi. It does not independently prove an ancient sound correspondence or the proposed quiver etymology.
evidence.title: 教育部《異體字字典》— 𤰈

evidence.source: 漢語多功能字庫（Chinese Character Database, Chinese University of Hong Kong）
evidence.text: The database interprets 𤰈 as arrows in a container and says some bronze forms replace its lower portion with 用, tentatively treating 用 as a sound element in 𤰈 and 備. This is a source analysis; the component’s independent early pronunciation is not established by this page.
evidence.title: 漢語甲骨部件分析 — 𤰈

evidence.source: 教育部《異體字字典》 Ministry of Education Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants (Taiwan)
evidence.field: 備 entry; 說文釋形 and reading
evidence.text: The 備 entry gives the received analysis “慎也。从人，𤰈聲” and Mandarin bèi. It supports describing the received account as phonosemantic, with 人 and 𤰈, while treating the phonetic interpretation as a transmitted analysis rather than independent proof of ancient sound correspondence.
evidence.title: 教育部《異體字字典》— 備

evidence.field: File description, source, original-file URL and reuse license
evidence.text: The Commons page identifies 備-seal.svg as a modern vector redraw in Shuowen seal-script style, says it draws on Academia Sinica and other character databases, and states CC0 1.0 reuse. Its inspected original-file link resolves to https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/ff/%E5%82%99-seal.svg, though fetching that link through the web tool returned a cache miss. The drawing is not an ancient artifact photograph; its pixels were not visually inspected here.
evidence.title: File:備-seal.svg — Wikimedia Commons

evidence.text: Attempts to open the official codepoint-specific Unihan records for 備 (U+5099) and 𤰈 (U+24C08) were inaccessible in this invocation. Current readings above therefore rely on inspected dictionary pages, not those Unihan records.

search_audit.outcome: Search surfaced the CUHK component and 備 pages and variant-dictionary records. Opened the CUHK pages and the Taiwan Ministry entries for 備 and 𤰈; the Ministry source supplies 𤰈 bèi and explicitly identifies it as a component in 備.
The official character-specific Unihan record could not be opened through the web tool.

search_audit.query: follow-up via inspected 備-seal.svg Commons links: 備 seal-script image original file
search_audit.outcome: The direct seal image fetch failed with a cache miss. Related style categories did not provide an alternate 備 image description, so only the seal redraw has a verified description-page identity and direct URL in this pass.

gaps: The current Mandarin readings for 備 and 𤰈 were not confirmed from their official Unihan records because both codepoint-specific pages were inaccessible; inspected Taiwan Ministry entries give bèi for both.

The inspected sources support a received phonetic analysis for 𤰈 in 備, but no matched historical reconstruction for the two characters was verified in a single named reconstruction system during this run.

The exact Commons seal redraw description and CC0 rights were verified, but its direct image fetch returned a cache miss. The previously attempted bronze URL returned 404 and remains unavailable; the oracle description page could not be opened. No image pixels were visually inspected.
